plans.idea: Product-led split: the bottle and "Glow." form one tight lockup on the left, and the brand sign-off (logo + SHOP SOLSTICE) forms a matching group on the right, with deliberate open space in the middle instead of four evenly scattered fragments.
Brand bookends: logo anchors the far left, a centered headline-plus-bottle pair carries the message in the middle, and the CTA closes on the far right, so the strip reads brand → message → action.
Headline-first: a big "Glow." opens the strip, the bottle sits right beside it, the CTA follows straight on as the action, and the logo signs off small at the far right.
